description: This file defines an interface class 'IOmiProxy' for interacting with an omi_dbus_api. The interface includes methods for mounting and unmounting crypted bundles, as well as registering and unregistering error listeners. It is intended to be implemented by classes that provide the actual communication logic for OCI container management, specifically related to error handling and secure bundle operations.

classes.name: omi::IOmiProxy
classes.description: An interface class providing methods for crypted bundle management and listener registration, designed for OCI container operations within the omi framework.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given its ID and paths, returning the path to the decrypted config if successful.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle identified by its ID.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback, returning a listener ID.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered listener by its ID.

ctags.name: OmiErrorListener
ctags.pattern: /^    typedef std::function<void(const std::string&, ErrorType, const void*)> OmiErrorListener;$/
